edits.old: CASE WHEN r.app_version IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN regexp_matches(trim(cast(r.app_version AS VARCHAR)), '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+|)$') THEN trim(cast(r.app_version AS VARCHAR)) ELSE NULL END AS app_version
edits.new: CASE WHEN regexp_matches(cast(r.app_version AS VARCHAR), '^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$') OR regexp_matches(cast(r.app_version AS VARCHAR), '^[0-9]+$') THEN cast(r.app_version AS VARCHAR) ELSE NULL END AS app_version

edits.old: WHERE try_cast(r.date AS DATE) IS NOT NULL
edits.new: WHERE cast(coalesce(try_strptime(r.date,'%Y-%m-%d'),try_strptime(r.date,'%d-%m-%Y'),try_strptime(r.date,'%b %d, %Y')) as date) IS NOT NULL
